articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Support System for Aquatic Plant Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Communications and Future Internet (ICCFI)
abstract: Even though aquatic plant cultivation for enjoyment and ornamental fish care is becoming more popular, creating a steady habitat for aquatic plants to thrive and flourish is one of the issues with aquatic plants. Most aquarists in Vietnam are more familiar with estimating the nutrients needed to supplement plants than with pinpointing environmental conditions for plant growth. The research was conducted with the desire to propose a solution for growing aquatic plants based on Internet of Things (IoT) technology. Because aquariums are typically kept indoors, proactively adjusting the light by using LEDs and checking and adjusting the temperature and pH of the water to maintain a reasonable level by changing the water benefits the plants. Environmental parameters are monitored and controlled fully automatically according to pre-programmed programs based on plant type and growth stage so that aquatic plants have good growth environments. The system also allows remote control by users via either a web or an Android application. This is useful for monitoring plant growth and increasing yields when farming on a large scale, as well as remotely caring for aquatic plants for decorative purposes when the owner is away. Several experiments have been carried out to evaluate the results of this proposed system, with initial positive results.

articleTitle: Malvertising in AI-Powered Chat Platforms: Utilizing Integrated Artificial Intelligence Solutions for Threat Detection and Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Communications and Future Internet (ICCFI)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has opened new opportunities for efficiency and client interaction in banking platforms. But this progress has also presented cybersecurity issues, especially considering the growing prevalence of malvertising that targets AI chatbots. This review paper examines banking AI chat platforms' malvertising strategies, assesses vulnerabilities, and suggests AI-driven solutions for threat detection and mitigation. We synthesized a multilayered integrated AI-driven solution that integrates machine learning algorithms, cross-referencing methods, end-to-end encryption, and blockchain technology after carefully examining real-world case studies and latest research findings of existing related solutions. Our findings show the need to give cybersecurity top priority when developing and implementing AI, the importance of banking institutions, cybersecurity experts, and policymakers' collaboration, and how using AI technologies can improve threat detection and mitigation capabilities. The results concluded and recommendation approach serves to be an informative reminder for the associated risk in using an AI-powered services for financial matters and the critical need for preventive cybersecurity solutions.

articleTitle: Smart Avian: Enhancing Indian Ring-Necked Parakeet Welfare Through Automated Cage Systems and Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Communications and Future Internet (ICCFI)
abstract: This study presents the development and evaluation of the Smart Avian, an innovative system designed to enhance the care and management of Indian Ring-Necked Parakeets. Leveraging smart technologies such as environmental sensors, automation mechanisms, and mobile connectivity, the system enables real-time monitoring, automated adjustments, and remote management of essential parameters within the bird cage. The research methodology employed a mixed-methods approach, combining quantitative assessment through user surveys and qualitative evaluation via in-depth interviews and focus group discussions. Results indicate high user satisfaction with the system's usability, functionality, and overall effectiveness. Key findings highlight the intuitive design of the mobile application, the convenience of real-time monitoring features, and suggestions for further improvements, such as enhancing data synchronization and expanding feature sets. The Smart Avian represents a significant advancement in avian care technology, promising to revolutionize the well-being of Indian Ring-Necked Parakeets and setting a precedent for future avian husbandry advancements.

articleTitle: A Study on Amazon Product Satisfaction: Based on Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Communications and Future Internet (ICCFI)
abstract: Customer-generated product feedback is crucial for e-commerce sellers launching new products, as it significantly impacts brand reputation and profitability. Traditionally, businesses must wait passively for such feedback, potentially wasting opportunity costs. To address this, we develop a predictive model for online product satisfaction. We employ statistical and machine learning tools, including Interquartile Range (IQR) and RoBERTa, a natural language processing model, to evaluate product satisfaction. This incorporates average star rating, review text content, number of helpful votes, and verified purchases to increase assessment accuracy. Furthermore, we analyze the influence of five product listing features-price, item weight, manufacturer, color, and country of origin-on product satisfaction. Based on these insights, we construct a multivariate prediction model with XGBoost (a popular machine learning algorithm used for prediction and classification tasks), which supports businesses in preemptively identifying market risks and optimizing product strategies right at the outset of a product launch.

articleTitle: The Acceptance and Usage of ChatGPT: An Information Adoption Model perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Communications and Future Internet (ICCFI)
abstract: Currently, there are just a few studies that sought to explore aspects influencing the users' engagement with generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) large language models (LLMs) like OpenAI's Chat Generative Pre-Trained Transformer (ChatGPT). To the best of the authors' knowledge, for the time being, there are no contributions that have validated the information adoption model (IAM) to investigate individual perceptions in terms of their confidence levels in the content generated by GenAI algorithms. This research identifies the factors that may induce online users to rely on the information produced by ChatGPT. The methodology integrates IAM constructs, namely, information relevance, information accuracy, source trustworthiness and information usefulness to better understand the extent to which they have an impact on information adoption. Data were gathered from a sample of three hundred twenty-seven (n=327) higher education students. The results from SmartPLS indicated that there were highly significant effects in the proposed structured model. The strongest link was reported between information usefulness and information adoption. However, another noteworthy finding of this study confirmed that information relevance exhibited a substantial influence on information usefulness. In sum, this contribution puts forward a robust conceptual model that is empirically grounded. It sheds light on the users' perceptions about the factors that are influencing their adoption of ChatGPT.

articleTitle: Improving Stock Index Prediction Based on Financial Sentiment Analysis and Time Series Models
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Communications and Future Internet (ICCFI)
abstract: Stock market prediction remains one of the most challenging tasks due to the complex interactions of multiple factors. In this study, we propose a novel stock index prediction method based on financial sentiment analysis and multivariate time series models, to maximize the use of prior information in stock market for better predictive performance. Specifically, a CoEmoBERT model is proposed to achieve better sentiment classification accuracy and f1-score of stock-related tweets on StockEmotions dataset than single language model. Through vector concatenation, we then combine historical stock market index(S&P 500) data from Yahoo Finance with the sentiment labels and comment texts into a series of vectors as model inputs. Finally, leveraging long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, we achieve stock market index predictions with a mean squared error (MSE) of 0.80 ×10-3. This represents a 3.62% improvement in performance over similar index predictions conducted using the StockE motions dataset. Our data and codes are available at https://github.com/yhliu04/CoEmoBERT_OneHotLSTM

articleTitle: Virtual Clinic Design Based on Unity 3D and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Communications and Future Internet (ICCFI)
abstract: This paper proposes its Virtual Clinic, an innovative healthcare model, which is aimed at enhancing the healthcare access and quality globally through the combining of the Internet of Things (IoT) technology with three-dimensional virtual reality (3D VR). The primary goal of the project is to address medical gaps caused by regional and societal variety by using virtual characters in place of actual patients. In order to facilitate people to obtain more convenient and effective medical services, this study developed a technical framework to present health data in a three-dimensional virtual reality scene, that is, VR. The full virtualization of the system provides a secure real-time IoT data transmission platform for communication between patients and doctors. In addition, in order to develop a personalized medical plan, machine learning technology will be used to process patients' health data and then predict patients' health outcomes. The purpose of this study is to integrate these technologies into the healthcare system and use them to improve patients' medical experience, thereby contributing to the possibility of promoting different medical service development models. In addition, this study also explains the important issues and challenges encountered in this research.

articleTitle: Determinants of Attitudes and Adoption Intentions Toward M-Commerce Chatbots
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Communications and Future Internet (ICCFI)
abstract: M-commerce chatbots offer automated, 24/7 services to facilitate product recommendations, order and status updates, customer support, and payment processes. However, reports indicate that user adoption of m-commerce chatbots has been lukewarm. While understanding the factors that drive the adoption of m-commerce chatbots is important, relatively less research has focused on the Malaysian context compared to Western countries and other Asian nations. This research aims to fill that gap by investigating the factors influencing attitudes and intentions to use m-commerce chatbots through the lens of an extended Technology Acceptance Model (TAM). Based on 375 valid responses from online shoppers in Malaysia, the PLS-SEM results highlight the significant roles of perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, perceived enjoyment, anthropomorphism, social presence, and trust in fostering positive attitudes toward m-commerce chatbots and the intention to use this technology. Conversely, perceived risk negatively impacts attitudes toward m-commerce chatbots. The study also confirms that attitude acts as a mediator between these factors and the intention to use m-commerce chatbots. The practical implications derived from this study provide managerial and design recommendations for promoting positive user attitudes and increasing the use intention of m-commerce chatbots.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics and Health Monitoring Integration in NextGen Smart TERRY: Ensuring Optimal Habitat for Bearded Dragons
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Communications and Future Internet (ICCFI)
abstract: This study integrates predictive maintenance and health monitoring systems into NextGen Smart TERRY, an automated habitat for bearded dragons. The objective was to leverage predictive analytics to enhance habitat conditions and reptile well-being. Predictive maintenance algorithms achieved a high prediction accuracy of 95.6%, with low false positive and negative rates. Health monitoring sensors, including temperature, humidity, UVB, infrared, heart rate, and activity levels, provided accurate and consistent data. Predictive models for environmental conditions demonstrated high accuracy, with temperature and light predictions at 96.2% and 95.8%, respectively. User evaluations indicated high satisfaction, particularly praising the system's accuracy, reliability, and valuable insights. Validation tests confirmed significant improvements over previous systems, especially in equipment failure prediction and environmental condition accuracy. This study concludes that integrating predictive maintenance and health monitoring in NextGen Smart TERRY effectively ensures optimal habitat conditions for bearded dragons, highlighting the potential of advanced analytics in automated animal care.

articleTitle: PhleboLab: An Interactive Web-Based 2D Virtual Laboratory for Phlebotomy Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Communications and Future Internet (ICCFI)
abstract: Digital transformation has transformed the field of education, shifting from a traditional learning process to a modern online learning mode. One aspect of online electronic learning (e-learning) is virtual laboratories, widely used in health sciences. In the discipline of medical technology, phlebotomy is one of the essential concepts that a student must learn. The primary objective of this study was to design and develop an interactive web-based 2D virtual laboratory for phlebotomy learning utilized by medical technology students. The study employed a quasi-experimental and quantitative research design to assess the usability of the developed system and to evaluate the effectiveness of the developed system in aiding medical technology students in learning about the basics of phlebotomy. The developed system performed well in terms of usability, effectively meeting the experimental treatment's objectives. Pre and post-test results have shown that the PhleboLab web application was effective in aiding medical technology students in learning about the basics of phlebotomy, specifically on the equipment and techniques used, in comparison to traditional learning methods as the total score of students who belonged in the experimental group increased from 58.67% to 73.33% with a difference of 14.66%. The control group has also slightly improved its total score in the post-test, with an increase of 5.78<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, from 63.11% to 68.89%.

articleTitle: Rapid Positioning in Smart Power Warehousing: A Multi-Modal RF Wireless Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Conference on Communications and Future Internet (ICCFI)
abstract: The paper explores the transition from traditional Internet of Things (IoT) to passive IoT systems using backscatter communication to meet green and low-carbon requirements in smart power storage. It highlights the challenge of implementing large-scale RF wireless charging networks and proposes a novel integration of backscatter communication with passive IoT and mobile relay wireless charging. This integration enables efficient bidirectional wireless energy transfer, enhancing the flexibility and portability of power storage and charging solutions. To address the need for enhanced coverage and accurate location tracking for power material storage management, the study introduces a large-scale RF wireless charging network that employs mobile relay devices to minimize interference and improve location-aware flexibility. A rapid passive positioning strategy is proposed, optimizing the system to use only two RF sources for locating high-power charging sources, significantly reducing interference. Through simulation, the paper compares dual RF source positioning to triple RF source positioning, demonstrating that the dual-point approach substantially increases target coverage rates, achieving a threefold improvement over multipoint positioning. This research presents a significant step forward in the development of green, efficient power storage systems in the IoT domain.
